Review Shopify?

Reviewers broadly see Shopify as a polished, easy way to launch and run an online store fast, with an intuitive interface, strong themes and apps, reliable performance, and solid support for multichannel and international selling. The main complaint is cost: as stores grow, apps, themes, transaction fees, and payment restrictions can make pricing feel unpredictable or steep. Customization is another trade-off, with advanced needs often pushing merchants toward apps or custom development. Some also mention weak support and limits around alternative payment methods.
